B is slightly better. Both cover the same core problems in a similar order and stay near the 200-word limit. B's fixes are more concrete: it gives the exact `cd ... || exit 1` line, a specific validation regex that also rejects dot-prefixed names, and a concrete example of what the dotfile bug leaves behind (`.cache/`, `.npm/`). B also notes that the line-based count miscounts filenames containing newlines, a real if minor point that A misses.

B
